verdict.rationale: Luma documents a generation API with SDKs and agent-readable docs (llms.txt, .md mirrors, per-endpoint OpenAPI blocks for creategeneration), so an agent can submit a prompt from docs alone. Cost is published only as per-model credit pricing (e.g. 20 credits for a 5s draft) plus a billing dashboard. The current-generation docs are flagged as split from the legacy reference, which carries the OpenAPI definitions. missing for 10: documented job-status polling or callbacks for watching the job, a documented asset-download step, per-job cost reported in API responses, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost

citations.quote: Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
Luma's legacy Dream Machine API reference publishes per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the markdown mirror of every reference page
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
